scene_end_anchor: Rhea successfully crafted the Makeshift Masonry Bludgeon using the Obsidian Shard and a Raw Masonry Chunk. Upon equipping the weapon, the System interface glitched and flickered purple. The System failed to apply a tax assessment to the unregistered asset, securing Rhea her first debt-free advantage.
